title: The User Registration & Membership WordPress plugin before 5.3.2 does not verify that a discount coupon applied to a…
description: A vulnerability in the User Registration & Membership WordPress plugin before version 5.3.2 allows unauthenticated users to exploit improperly validated discount coupons. This flaw permits users to obtain roles mapped to paid membership plans without payment, potentially escalating privileges up to administrator if the plan is linked to a privileged role.
